solution.p: Here are two different explanations of how two negative numbers can be added together.
Use a number line. Lets find 3+(-6).
First, find 3 on the number line. Next, since we are adding a negative number, we move left, in the negative direction, by 6 units. We will reach {-3} on the number line, which is the answer.
A second method asks you to think in terms of money. Lets find 3+(-6).
The first number is 3. Since its positive, its like you won 3 dollars while gambling at the casino this morning.
The second number is -6. Since its negative, its like you lost 6 dollars while gambling at the casino this afternoon.
Since you lost more money than you won, overall you have lost, implying the answer is negative.
Since you won 3 dollars and then lost 6 dollars, it makes sense that you lost the difference of 6 and 3 dollars, which is {3} dollars. So the final answer is: 3+(-6)={-3}.
